overview: Retrospective comparison of completion between remote and centre-based cardiac rehabilitation using programme records for all referrals from January 2023 to December 2025.
population: All 1,146 adults referred after myocardial infarction, stenting or bypass surgery who chose a programme; each patient's first referral only.
exposure: Programme chosen at the booking call: remote (436) or centre-based (710).
procedures: The analyst extracts referral date, diagnosis, age, sex, postcode (converted to deprivation quintile and road distance, then deleted), programme chosen, sessions attended or coaching weeks completed, and six-minute walk distances. Completion is derived with one attendance-equivalent rule written before extraction.

outcomes.name: Completion
outcomes.measure: At least 12 of 16 sessions (centre) or 6 of 8 coaching weeks (remote), all referrals who chose a programme in the denominator
outcomes.timing: Eight weeks from the first scheduled session
outcomes.why: The board's question and the benefit patients lose by dropping out.

outcomes.name: Weeks engaged before stopping
outcomes.measure: Last week with an attended session or completed call
outcomes.why: Shows when each programme loses patients.

outcomes.name: Change in six-minute walk distance among completers
outcomes.measure: End minus start distance in metres
outcomes.why: Described for completers only, never compared as an effect.

outcomes.name: Uptake of each programme by group
outcomes.measure: Proportion choosing remote by sex, age group, deprivation quintile and distance band

feasibility: About 30 analyst hours for extraction, derivation and the model; records exist for all referrals.
biasMitigation: One completion rule fixed before extraction
Adjustment for age, sex, diagnosis, deprivation quintile and distance

biasFlags.label: Confounding by choice
biasFlags.note: Employment and car access are not recorded; the E-value states how strong they would need to be.

biasFlags.label: Definition bias
biasFlags.note: Handled by one rule; the published regional comparison failed here.

biasFlags.label: Selective outcome recording
biasFlags.note: Walk distance exists only for completers.

flags: Five adjustment variables fixed in advance
parsimony.simplestPath: One exposure, one completion rule, one adjusted model, subgroup reporting.

theoreticalFramework: No framework; the analysis follows STROBE with the RECORD extension.
summary: One completion rule, full denominators and five pre-specified adjustment variables.
